issuing_body: AI Strategy Promotion Inter-Ministerial Conference (Cabinet Office)

evidence.quote:
既存の法令やガイドラインの運用、実態把
握等を、引き続き緊密な連携の下で進めるよう関係省庁へ依頼した。
evidence.quote_en: requested the relevant ministries and agencies to continue advancing the operation of existing laws and guidelines and grasping actual conditions under close coordination.

implementation_notes: Summary of minutes (議事要旨) of the 2nd meeting of Japan's AI Strategy Promotion Inter-Ministerial Conference held on 2025-05-14 (Reiwa 7; meeting date used as publication_date). Non-binding inter-ministerial coordination record covering Diet deliberation updates on the AI Bill, the Digital Agency's draft guidelines on government AI procurement and utilization (including requests for ministries to appoint Chief AI Officers and track AI usage), the Financial Services Agency's AI Discussion Paper (v1.0), METI's GENIAC-PRIZE program for generative AI, MIC's regional AI policy discussions, and plans to incorporate AI measures into the Integrated Innovation Strategy.
